title: This Wasp Paralyzes a Cicada, Then Flies It Home Alive

scenes.text: This wasp stings a cicada and flies off with it.
Females grow up to about an inch and a half long.
One precise sting paralyzes the cicada without killing it.
She carries prey as heavy as she is, or heavier.
Down in her burrow, she lays an egg on the helpless cicada.
The larva eats it while it's still alive.

description:
The cicada killer wasp paralyzes a cicada with one sting, then carries it to her burrow, even when it weighs as much as she does or more.
She lays an egg on it, and the larva feeds on the cicada while it is still alive.
Would you want one near your garden?
first_comment: What is the scariest insect you have seen?
